_meta.description: Expected answers for the 18 example questions in 03-evaluation-queries.md (sample dataset, 200 wells). Transcribed by hand; machine-checked by eval/scoring.py.
_meta.run_order: Questions run top to bottom in ONE process against ONE database, so stateful questions work. 'depends_on' = hard prerequisites (history/state the question needs; auto-included by `--only`). 'runs_after' = ordering only (the question would see a different answer if it ran later).
_meta.turn_model: Each entry has an optional list of pre_turns, then the primary turn (question_text/user_id/expected), then optional post_turns. A turn with an 'expected' block is scored; one without is setup only (e.g. a user stating a fact). All turns sharing a 'conversation' label are one chat; a different label is a new chat. The question passes only if every scored turn passes.

expected_keys.visual_type: string | list of acceptable strings | null (not checked)
expected_keys.text_contains: list; each item is a string or a list of alternatives (any-of); case-insensitive substring
expected_keys.text_not_contains: list of substrings that must be absent
expected_keys.numbers: {name: value}; value must appear in text within 0.5% (structured IDs and dates are ignored)
expected_keys.visual_numbers: same, searched in the JSON of visual.data
expected_keys.well_ids_in_data: well IDs that must appear in visual.data
expected_keys.well_ids_not_in_data: well IDs that must NOT appear in visual.data
expected_keys.visual_data_contains: substrings that must appear in the JSON of visual.data
expected_keys.citations_must_include: source_ids that must be present in citations
expected_keys.conflicts_min: minimum number of entries in conflicts
expected_keys.<key>_optional: any check key with this suffix is reported as a warning and never fails the question

Q1.question_text: Is WELL-0001 producing oil right now? When was it last inspected, and by whom? Show me its status card.

Q2.question_text: Which wells in Northeast Block 8 are not producing oil right now, and why? Show them in a table.
Q2.notes: Runs before Q12 mutates WELL-0164. Two wells (0164, 0175) have no recorded reason; the answer must say so rather than invent a cause.

Q3.question_text: Show a line chart of WELL-0001's wellhead temperature against air temperature for the last 13 weeks, and mark when it was not producing oil.

Q4.question_text: How many oil spills has WELL-0001 had in the last 4 years, and how much oil in total? List them in a table.
Q4.notes: 7 detections, but INS-0001-0070 was corrected as rainwater (CTX-0001-001) and must not count.

Q5.question_text: How many days was WELL-0001 down in 2025?
Q5.notes: No visual needed. 3 weekly inspections x 7 days. The 24 Jul reading (51.6 C wellhead, 43.1 C air) is a trap: only the 8.5 C delta matters. The MNT causes live in repair records/reports (no dedicated tool), so they are optional.

Q6.question_text: Which 3 wells in Northeast Block 7 had the most downtime in the last 4 months? Show a bar chart.
Q6.notes: Asked by Michael Turner (U-201) because Q11 ('the three wells we discussed yesterday') relies on his history. Window 16 Jun - 16 Oct 2026. WELL-0119 (28 days) is 4th and must not appear.

Q7.question_text: Show on a map every well in Northeast Block 8 with a real spill in the last 90 days.
Q7.notes: Must run before Q13, which changes WELL-0151's volume from 4.5 to 5.4 bbl.

Q8.question_text: Show a heatmap of 2026 spills by geographic area and month.
Q8.notes: Area totals: SW-23 35, SW-24 43, NE-7 37, NE-8 26 (corrected detections removed).

Q9.question_text: Which rules has WELL-0001 broken in the last 12 months, and what is still open?
Q9.notes: 4 breaches from the 11 Jun 2026 spill (6.8 bbl): SR-01 (41 h vs 24 h, REG-0001-001, NOV REG-0001-002, USD 5,000 open), SR-02 (~7 h vs 4 h, only in the June report), SR-03 (due 10 Aug, REG-0001-003 open), RC-04 (response due 30 Jul, none). Pending: flowline RCA (MNT-0001-028/-029/-032), planned shut-in CTX-0001-003 not in maintenance system. RC-02 was met (7 Mar 2026).

Q10.question_text: In Southwest Block 24, which spills in the last 90 days were not contained within the SOP time limit?
Q10.notes: Containment times exist only inside free-text repair reports (search_reports needed). Limit is 4 h (SR-02).

Q11.question_text: For the three wells we discussed yesterday, what have repairs cost this year?
Q11.notes: Day 2, Michael Turner, new chat. Needs his Q6 history (recall_user_context). Q1-Q5/Q7-Q10 are asked by Ashley Bennett (U-203) so Michael's history holds only Q6, like the real scenario.

Q12.notes: Correction recorded on INS-0164-0205 (original 24.0 kept). WELL-0164 flips to producing; the inspector note 'Pump jack not moving.' (Tyler Hughes) conflicts and Michael is asked to confirm. Then Michael re-asks Q2: three wells, WELL-0164 gone.

Q13.notes: Correction recorded on INS-0151-0201 (AI estimate 4.5 kept). 5.4 bbl is reportable (>= 5): SR-01 written notice due 24 h after 24 Sep 15:30, none on record -> possible breach.
